Third-party notices: Android native relay, secure storage and invitation scanner

This application includes the components listed below. Each retains its own
license. Full license text and upstream source records are in this directory.
The component versions correspond to the bundled source snapshot or declared
Maven artifacts; libsodium 1.0.20 is the version embedded in the four native
libraries distributed in lazysodium-android 5.2.0.

The common-relay and flutter_secure_storage Java sources are adapted; details
are recorded in their adjacent SOURCE.json files. These ports do not include a
Flutter engine. Dependencies are used as published, without source modification.

Lazysodium covered source is available under Mozilla Public License 2.0 at:
https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/com/goterl/lazysodium-android/5.2.0/lazysodium-android-5.2.0-sources.jar
That source archive includes the Android and shared Java classes present in the
published artifact. The MPL applies to those covered files, not automatically
to the entire application. Native libsodium has its separate ISC license.

For JNA this distribution chooses Apache License 2.0 from the upstream dual
license. See Apache-2.0.txt as well as jna-LICENSE.txt and the bundled libffi
copyright/license. ZXing upstream notices are retained in zxing-NOTICE.txt;
some notices in the full upstream distribution may concern modules not used
by this application. OkHttp public suffix data retains its upstream notice
at okhttp3/internal/publicsuffix/NOTICE inside the APK.
